claims: As of April 2026, NASA has not yet announced the specific crewmembers for the Artemis III mission.
Artemis III mission is currently planned for a 2027 launch.
Artemis III mission is planned to test docking in low Earth orbit.
Artemis III will fly on a Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis III will rendezvous with a commercial lunar lander (Starship or Blue Moon).
Artemis III mission will focus on testing rendezvous and docking capabilities between the Orion spacecraft and human landing systems in Earth orbit.
NASA named 18 astronauts in 2020 involved in previous Artemis training exercises.
Artemis II is the immediate prior mission to Artemis III.
Artemis II will orbit the Moon in early 2026.
Artemis II crew includes Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis III is for testing the SpaceX Starship or Blue Moon lander with the Axiom Extravehicular Mobility Unit (AxEMU) space suits.
